title: 工業力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics I
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn the basic concepts of static mechanics.
(2) learn what kind of forces act on rigid bodies.
(3) learn how to calculate the balance condition of forces.
(4) learn how to calculate the center of gravity.
advice:
This is a basic engineering mechanics course.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Kinds of forces
2. Synthesis and decomposition of forces
3. Balance of forces
4. Moments of forces
5. Center of gravity of rigid bodies
Classes will be held on 22 classes(the basis of every 1.5 classes/week).
Students will also learn about advanced issues not included in the textbooks.
Students will be expected to understand the meanings of the terms and formulas.
Students will be expected to solve the exercises on their own.
Students are required to review each unit with on-demand learning materials.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of lectures, quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should not be absent from the class, as handouts may be not received.
requiredKnowledge:
Sufficient skill in mathematics (especially basical knowidgement of trigonometric functions,differentiation/integration and vector composition.)
Basic knowledge of mechanics
How to use a scientific calculator

activityGoals.body: Be able to indicate the forces on rigid bodies and to describe using SI unit correctly
Be able to synthesize and decomposit forces
Be able to calculate the moments of forces
Be able to formulate the balance of forces and moments of forces
Be able to calculate the center of gravity for rigid bodies
Be able to explain the stability of rigid bodies

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Indicate the forces using any coordinates.
(2) Decompose forces in any directions and synthesize forces.
acting at different points and in different directions.
(3) Calculate three dimensional moment vectors.
(4) Calculate local load on the actual rigid bodies.
(5) Calculate the center of gravity of actual rigid bodies.
(6) Evaluate the stability of actual rigid bodies.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain the three elements to indicate force vectors, and describe forces using SI unit.
(2) Decompose forces into the three directions x, y, z and synthesize three forces at different points of application.
(3) Calculate moment of force acting on rigid bodies, and indicate in suitable SI units.
(4) Calculate the reaction force at rotational support points.
(5) Calculate the center of gravity of an object which is composed of two simple rigid bodies.
(6) Evaluate the stability of a simple rigid body.
